children.name: Oleandra
children.description: Oleandra — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Oleandra amazonica
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Amazonas). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra angusta
children.description: The native range of this species is Solomon Is. (Kolombangara, Makira) to Santa Cruz Is. (Vanikoro). It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra annetii
children.description: The native range of this species is Ivory Coast, Cameroon, Bioko, Seychelles. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra articulata
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Veracruz, Oaxaca, Chiapas) to Trop. America. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra australis
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Paraná). It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra baetae
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo).

children.name: Oleandra bradei
children.description: The native range of this species is Costa Rica. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra brasiliana
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Brazil. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra coriacea
children.description: The native range of this species is Borneo.

children.name: Oleandra cumingii
children.description: The native range of this species is Nepal to S. China and Malesia. It is a epiphyte or lithophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra decurrens
children.description: The native range of this species is Costa Rica to Panama. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra distenta
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & S. Africa, W. Indian Ocean. It is a epiphyte or lithophyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra ejurana
children.description: The native range of this species is Ghana.

children.name: Oleandra guatemalensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Guatemala. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra hirta
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Rio de Janeiro). It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra hovenkampii
children.description: The native range of this species is Costa Rica, Peru. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra lehmannii
children.description: The native range of this species is Costa Rica to Venezuela and Peru. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra musifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan, Guangxi) to Trop. Asia and Queensland. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra neriiformis
children.description: The native range of this species is Indo-China to S. Pacific. It is a scrambling epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra pilosa
children.description: The native range of this species is Trinidad to S. Trop. America. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra pistillaris
children.description: The native range of this species is Nepal to W. New Guinea. It is a perennial or epiphyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra quartziticola
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Espírito Santo). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra sibbaldii
children.description: The native range of this species is Malesia to S. Pacific. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra steyermarkii
children.description: The native range of this species is Venezuela. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra undulata
children.description: The native range of this species is S. India, China (Yunnan) and Indo-China. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra vulpina
children.description: The native range of this species is New Guinea. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Oleandra wallichii
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to China (Sichuan, Yunnan, Guangxi) and Indo-China, Taiwan. It is a epiphyte or lithophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra welwitschii
children.description: The native range of this species is Congo to Angola. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra werneri
children.description: The native range of this species is Maluku (Seram) to Vanuatu. It is a scrambling epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Oleandra zapatana
children.description: The native range of this species is Colombia (Chocó), Bolivia (Beni, La Paz). It is a epiphyte.
